method: Exact declared scenario axes or default HTML axes; fixed 0-10 rubric in evals/src/llm-judge.ts. Bounded source review (20 KiB per artifact); no additional interactive browser review. Packets omit model names, but the operator can see campaign metadata; this is not a double-blind study. Advisory scores never modify the objective composite.
